model.name: Blue Archive-like Charge
model.blurb: Both banners have a 0.7% pickup rate. At 100 points, you get a 3-star with a 50% pickup chance; at 200, the pickup is guaranteed. A pickup resets the meter, and same-type banners share points.
model.source: Based on Blue Archive JP 5.5 Recruitment Charge (29 July 2026) and the Wiki/Yostar/Inven write-up: at 100 charge, a 3-star is guaranteed with a 50% pickup chance; at 200, the pickup is guaranteed. A pickup on this banner resets charge. Regular and limited banners use separate pools, and banners of the same type share charge. This model does not copy a live drop table.
notes: Every pull adds charge. An off-banner 3-star does not reset it. Any pickup on this banner does, including a natural 0.7% hit.
When charge reaches 100, the roll is a 3-star with a 50% chance of the pickup. If you miss, the next 3-star is not guaranteed to be the pickup.
At 200 charge, the pickup is guaranteed and the meter resets to 0.
Regular and limited banners have separate meters. Banners of the same type share one, so getting A resets the progress you had toward B.

The 5.5 livestream announced the change a few days before it launched in JP. Producer Kim Yong-ha apologised, and recent Steam reviews fell to 'Overwhelmingly Negative.' Those write-ups did not announce a Global release date.
